api: mpv_create; mpv_initialize; mpv_command(loadfile, local tagged MP3 path); mpv_wait_event(MPV_EVENT_FILE_LOADED); mpv_get_property(metadata/by-key/title, track-list/0/codec, duration)
family: libmpv demux_lavf wrapper over FFmpeg ID3v2 reader and MP3 demuxer
family_note: Shares FFmpeg 9.0.2 libavformat/id3v2.c and libavformat/mp3dec.c with the direct FFmpeg row (projects/mp3_id3v2/c/ffmpeg) and shares libmpv 0.42.0 with the C++ mpv catalog row (catalog/mp3_id3v2/cpp/mpv); the catalog's Homebrew mpv linked the same libavformat.63.dylib the FFmpeg row records. mpv itself has no ID3v2 parser: avformat_open_input reads the tag before mp3dec.c parses the audio frames

build_dependencies.role: required by mpv 0.42.0 (>= 7.387.0); renderer only, not called by the null video output
required by mpv; subtitle renderer, not instrumented

valid_variant_note: Same MPEG audio frames as the control under an ID3v2.4 tag (synchsafe frame sizes, UTF-8 text), so the difference exercises FFmpeg's ID3v2 reader rather than the audio path
coverage: LLVM source coverage in the pinned mpv 0.42.0 demuxer layer (demux/demux_lavf.c) and the FFmpeg 9.0.2 libavformat sources it calls, including the ID3v2 reader (id3v2.c) and MP3 demuxer (mp3dec.c), all built from source with the same instrumentation and linked into a byte-input harness that loads a local file through libmpv
